title: Friday, 2 October 2026
lede: Cloudflare, Perplexity, and AWS put open decision models up the same day Pi 1.0 shipped Codemode, Figma locked remote MCP writes to a client catalog, and California subpoenaed OpenAI over agent breakouts.

title: Thursday, 1 October 2026
lede: Google gated Gemini 4 Argon to cyber defenders the same day CoreWeave put Vera Rubin under Cognition's Devin, Anthropic opened Claude for Government, and a limited-preview Decisions API still had no docs.

title: Wednesday, 30 September 2026
lede: OpenAI spent DevDay replacing a cancelled Astra follow-on with a cheaper Sol, an always-on Dot that has its own computer, and a $500 Ultrafast plan, the same window Google put Gemini and Grok on a federal front door, Muse handed a Marketplace buyer a home address, and Bain said the buildout now needs $6 trillion a year.
